Backing artists, opening education and defending the freedom to create

Since 2011, the Rambourg Foundation has supported people and ideas that build open, creative societies — wherever talent needs a chance to be seen and heard.

Our pillars Our story

Sarah and Guillaume Rambourg at a Rambourg Foundation evening

We create and foster paths to justice and fairness — empowering young people, giving them platforms to learn and thrive, and standing with artists and citizens when their freedom to speak is at stake.

Create

We fund artists, film-makers and cultural spaces, and help their work reach the world.

Learn

We open access to education and scholarships for talented young people.

Stand up

We defend human rights and freedom of expression, through culture and beyond.

    Partnership · Christie's London · 16 July – 22 August 2025

    MARWANA Soul in Exile

    We were proud to partner with Christie's on MARWAN: A Soul in Exile — some 150 powerful, deeply moving works by the iconic Syrian artist Marwan (1934–2016), whose faces became landscapes of the soul.

    Works
    Over 150, from 1953 to 2014
    Where
    Christie's, 8 King Street, London
    Curator
    Dr Ridha Moumni
    Lenders
    Museums & collections across Europe and the Middle East
